review.basis: Predicate statements are the verified design probes of contract SF-REQ-014 (acceptance_design_trace), independently VERIFIED by POSTW1-VERIFY-010, and the SF-REQ-014 acceptance criteria text. Runnable bindings (fixture, command, endpoint, guard) are PRODUCER-authored for FX-U4 and are themselves a judgment obligation of the independent VERIFIER. Nothing here is inferred from implementation code or passing tests.

predicates.statement: Pinned predicate and fixture/expected output exist before implementation evidence.
predicates.expected: FEASIBLE_PLAN whose every mechanical obligation carries controlled inputs, expected result, endpoint, command, evidence schema and named guard, linked to the requirement revision; an obligation lacking any of them holds INCOMPLETE_OBLIGATION and a mapping for another revision holds REVISION_MISMATCH

predicates.statement: Qualified intact/red/restored control rejects constant success and unrelated failure.
inputs: intact, fault and restored control runs with exit status, application count, failed assertions and errors
predicates.expected: QUALIFIED_KILL only for intact exit 0, exactly one application whose fault fails nonzero on the named assertion alone, and restored exit 0; UNCONDITIONAL_SUCCESS, ZERO_APPLICATION, OVERDETERMINED and UNRELATED_FAILURE otherwise; an implementation-derived predicate is CIRCULAR_ORACLE

predicates.statement: Four-part isolation fixture plus pinned platform capability premise avoids impossible credential-denial oracle.
predicates.expected: the plan pins the U3 PlatformIsolationPremise refs for the four observables; an obligation demanding CREDENTIAL_DENIAL or omitting an observable is U3 InfeasibleProof returned to source authority, never a plan

predicates.statement: Judgment obligations name reviewer/inputs; deletion is a coverage hold.
inputs: a mapping with a judgment predicate
the same mapping with a required predicate removed
predicates.expected: a judgment obligation without reviewer, inspection inputs or decision record holds UNATTRIBUTED_JUDGMENT; one claiming a mechanical command or PASS holds JUDGMENT_CLAIMS_MECHANICAL_PASS; an acceptance ID without a predicate holds COVERAGE_HOLD

predicates.statement: The FX-U4 runnable bindings faithfully realize the verified SF-REQ-014 design probes and infer nothing from implementation.
